reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: Septic, hypotensive 73 y with closed loop SBO and ischemia for emergent ex lap: INR 3.4 not reversed, Parkinson disease with 2 days of missed levodopa and fever, dopamine antagonist rigidity history, rasagiline, COPD with CO2 retention, AKI, and a full stomach.

asa.rationale: Septic shock physiology, AKI, COPD with hypercarbia, Parkinson disease, anticoagulation.

decision.rationale: Ischemic closed loop SBO cannot wait. Resuscitate in parallel: arterial line, norepinephrine, 4 factor PCC plus vitamin K before incision, NG suction then RSI, and a dopaminergic replacement plan.

redFlags.evidence: INR 3.4; vitamin K ordered 0950 not given; PCC not ordered; no FFP requested.
redFlags.action: 4 factor PCC plus vitamin K 10 mg IV before incision; recheck INR.

redFlags.finding: Missed levodopa with fever and rigidity
redFlags.evidence: Last carbidopa levodopa 10/25 2200; rigid, soft voice, T 38.5; neurology: risk of parkinsonism hyperpyrexia syndrome, suggest rotigotine patch; not ordered.
redFlags.implication: Parkinsonism hyperpyrexia, severe rigidity, respiratory compromise.
redFlags.action: Rotigotine transdermal patch now; avoid dopamine antagonists (metoclopramide, haloperidol, droperidol, prochlorperazine, promethazine).

redFlags.evidence: BP 88/50 after 30 mL/kg, HR 128 AF, T 38.5, lactate 3.1 to 4.6, UOP 20 mL/h, WBC 18.9.
redFlags.action: Arterial line before induction, norepinephrine running or ready, hemodynamically stable induction agents and reduced doses.

redFlags.finding: Bowel obstruction with large NG output
redFlags.action: Suction the NG before induction, RSI.

redFlags.evidence: Rasagiline 1 mg daily; neurology wallet card.
redFlags.implication: Avoid meperidine, tramadol, methadone, dextromethorphan; caution with indirect sympathomimetics.

redFlags.evidence: FEV1 61%, ABG pH 7.34, PaCO2 58, PaO2 64 on 4 L; weak cough from PD.
redFlags.action: Plan for postoperative ventilation in SICU, bronchodilators.

redFlags.finding: AKI after contrast, hypernatremia, hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis
redFlags.action: Replace K, renally adjust drugs, UOP monitoring.

redFlags.finding: PD orthostatic hypotension and prior postoperative delirium
redFlags.action: Careful titration; avoid anticholinergics and benzodiazepines where possible.

planItems.item: Arterial line, possibly central access for pressors
RSI after NG suction, reduced dose induction
PCC and vitamin K, crossmatched blood (2 units)
